name: @memberjunction/connector-schema-merge
description: Never-shrink field-schema union for integration connectors. mergeDeclaredWithSampledFields augments a connector's DECLARED (docs/spec) field set with fields observed by live SAMPLING (DiscoverFieldsViaFetch) — declared attributes stay authoritative, sampled fields fill gaps + add columns the docs didn't declare, and capacity attributes (MaxLength/Precision/Scale) take the max so a column is never sized smaller than either source. Connector-agnostic, dependency-light.
